examples.pinyin: Huárén xǐhuān xiàng èr, liù, bā de shùzì, zhè jǐ ge shùzì dōu shì shuāngshù, yǒu hěn duō hǎoshì yìqǐ lái de yìsi.
examples.english: Chinese people like numbers like two, six, and eight; these numbers are all even numbers, which means many good things come together.

examples.chinese: 顏太太很會保養，母子兩人站在一起時，看起來就像一對姊弟。
examples.pinyin: Yán tàitai hěn huì bǎoyǎng, mǔzǐ liǎng rén zhàn zài yīqǐ shí, kàn qǐlái jiù xiàng yī duì zǐdì.
examples.english: Mrs. Yan is very good at maintaining her appearance; when the mother and son stand together, they look like a pair of siblings.

examples.chinese: 救災工作不容易，一個人的力量是不夠的，得大家一起來。
examples.pinyin: Jiùzāi gōngzuò bù róngyì, yí ge rén de lìliàng shì bú gòu de, děi dàjiā yìqǐ lái.
examples.english: Disaster relief work is not easy; one person's strength is not enough—everyone needs to come together.

examples.chinese: 歐先生有閱讀的障礙，就算一篇極短的文章，讀起來也覺得很困難。
examples.pinyin: Ōu xiānsheng yǒu yuèdú de zhàng'ài, jiùsuàn yī piān jí duǎn de wénzhāng, dú qǐlái yě juéde hěn kùnnán.
examples.english: Mr. Ou has a reading obstacle; even a very short article feels difficult for him to read.

examples.chinese: 跟團體旅遊比起來，我覺得一個人的旅行自由得多，也能訓練自己解決問題的能力。
examples.pinyin: Gēn tuántǐ lǚyóu bǐ qǐlái, wǒ juéde yí ge rén de lǚxíng zìyóu de duō, yě néng xùnliàn zìjǐ jiějué wèntí de nénglì.
examples.english: Compared with group travel, I think traveling alone is much freer, and it can also train your ability to solve problems on your own.

examples.chinese: 何小姐地個性溫柔，笑起來也很迷人，所以追求她的人很多。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě de gèxìng wēnróu, xiào qǐlái yě hěn mírén, suǒyǐ zhuīqiú tā de rén hěn duō.
examples.english: Miss He has a gentle personality and her smile is very charming, so many people pursue her.

examples.chinese: 何先生的肩膀比較寬，這件襯衫他穿起來太緊了。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiānsheng de jiānbǎng bǐjiào kuān, zhè jiàn chènshān tā chuān qǐlái tài jǐn le.
examples.english: Mr. He's shoulders are rather wide; this shirt is too tight when he puts it on.

examples.chinese: 在所有的同事中，我覺得小周最好相處了。他的性格開朗、說話幽默，還常主動幫忙，跟他相處起來很愉快、很自在。
examples.pinyin: Zài suǒyǒu de tóngshì zhōng, wǒ juéde Xiǎo Zhōu zuì hǎo xiāngchǔ le. Tā de xìnggé kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, hái cháng zhǔdòng bāngmáng, gēn tā xiāngchǔ qǐlái hěn yúkuài, hěn zìzài.
examples.english: Among all my colleagues, I think Xiao Zhou is the easiest to get along with. He has a cheerful personality, speaks humorously, and often offers help proactively; getting along with him is very pleasant and relaxed.

examples.chinese: 當人們生活水準提高，開始重視生活品質時，休閒活動也就跟著多了起來。
examples.pinyin: Dāng rénmen shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn tígāo, kāishǐ zhòngshì shēnghuó pǐnzhí shí, xiūxián huódòng yě jiù gēnzhe duō le qǐlái.
examples.english: When people's standard of living rises and they begin to value quality of life, leisure activities then increase accordingly.

examples.chinese: A:聽說小金離婚了，你知道是怎麼回事嗎？ B:唉，這件事說起來都要怪小金，誰教他愛上了別的女生呢！
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō Xiǎo Jīn líhūn le, nǐ zhīdào shì zěnme huí shì ma? B: Āi, zhè jiàn shì shuō qǐlái dōu yào guài Xiǎo Jīn, shéi jiào tā ài shàng le bié de nǚshēng ne!
examples.english: A: I heard Xiao Jin got divorced. Do you know what happened? B: Sigh, as a matter of fact, it's all Xiao Jin's fault—who told him to fall in love with another girl!

examples.chinese:
跟大人比起來，小孩子的想法比較單純、天真，不會故意騙人。
A:網友跟我借十萬塊錢，說他的家人生病住院了。 B:你太天真了，他是騙你的。
examples.pinyin:
Gēn dàrén bǐ qǐlái, xiǎoháizi de xiǎngfǎ bǐjiào dānchún, tiānzhēn, bú huì gùyì piàn rén.
A: Wǎngyǒu gēn wǒ jiè shí wàn kuài qián, shuō tā de jiārén shēngbìng zhùyuàn le. B: Nǐ tài tiānzhēn le, tā shì piàn nǐ de.
examples.english:
Compared with adults, children's thinking is simpler and more innocent; they won't deliberately deceive people.
A: An online friend borrowed a hundred thousand dollars from me, saying his family member was sick and hospitalized. B: You're too naive; he's deceiving you.

examples.chinese: 警察抓到小偷後就把他帶到警察局，關了起來。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zhuādào xiǎotōu hòu jiù bǎ tā dàidào jǐngchájú, guān le qǐlái.
examples.english: After the police caught the thief, they took him to the police station and locked him up.

examples.chinese: 由於雲端科技的進步，人類的生活方式跟以往比起來有很大的差異。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yúnduān kējì de jìnbù, rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì gēn yǐwǎng bǐ qǐlái yǒu hěn dà de chāyì.
examples.english: Owing to advances in cloud technology, humans' way of life has great differences compared to the past.

examples.chinese: 他說的華語帶點兒家鄉口音，聽起來很親切。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de Huáyǔ dài diǎnr jiāxiāng kǒuyīn, tīng qǐlái hěn qīnqiè.
examples.english: The Mandarin he speaks carries a bit of a hometown accent, which sounds very warm and friendly.

examples.chinese: 我的鞋底快要掉下來了，得去店裡請人把它粘起來。他不管我忙不忙，老是黏著我聊天，讓我覺得有點煩。夏天的時候容易流汗，讓衣服變得黏黏的，真不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de xiédǐ kuàiyào diào xiàlái le, děi qù diànlǐ qǐng rén bǎ tā zhān qǐlái. Tā bùguǎn wǒ máng bù máng, lǎoshì niánzhe wǒ liáotiān, ràng wǒ juéde yǒudiǎn fán. Xiàtiān de shíhou róngyì liúhàn, ràng yīfu biànde niánnián de, zhēn bù shūfu.
examples.english: My shoe sole is about to fall off; I need to go to the shop and ask someone to glue it back on. Regardless of whether I'm busy or not, he's always clinging to me to chat, which makes me feel a bit annoyed. In summer, it's easy to sweat, making clothes sticky, which is really uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 這是我剛買回來的魚，吃起來又鮮又甜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ gāng mǎi huílái de yú, chī qǐlái yòu xiān yòu tián.
examples.english: This is the fish I just bought; it tastes both fresh and sweet.

examples.chinese: 我來臺灣，算起來才三個月而已，卻已去過十幾家茶館了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ lái Táiwān, suàn qǐlái cái sān ge yuè éryǐ, què yǐ qùguo shí jǐ jiā cháguǎn le.
examples.english: In total, it has only been three months since I came to Taiwan, yet I have already been to more than ten tea houses.

examples.chinese: 開早餐店很辛苦，大清早老闆就得起來準備。
examples.pinyin: Kāi zǎocāndiàn hěn xīnkǔ, dàqīngzǎo lǎobǎn jiù děi qǐlái zhǔnbèi.
examples.english: Running a breakfast shop is very hard; early in the morning, the owner has to get up to prepare.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡玻璃做的杯子，用起來比較安心，看起來也很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān bōli zuò de bēizi, yòng qǐlái bǐjiào ānxīn, kàn qǐlái yě hěn piàoliang.
examples.english: I like cups made of glass; they feel safer to use, and they look pretty too.

examples.chinese: 那件襯衫的材料百分之百是棉，穿起來十分舒服。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiàn chènshān de cáiliào bǎifēnzhī bǎi shì mián, chuān qǐlái shífēn shūfu.
examples.english: The material of that shirt is one hundred percent cotton, so it feels very comfortable to wear.

examples.chinese: 當掉進海裡的小孩被救上來時，大家都激動地歡呼了起來。
examples.pinyin: Dāng diào jìn hǎi lǐ de xiǎohái bèi jiù shànglái shí, dàjiā dōu jīdòng de huānhū le qǐlái.
examples.english: When the child who had fallen into the sea was rescued, everyone excitedly cheered.

examples.chinese: 彩色照片看起來很真實，不過黑白照片給人的感覺也很特別。
examples.pinyin: Cǎisè zhàopiàn kàn qǐlái hěn zhēnshí, bùguò hēibái zhàopiàn gěi rén de gǎnjué yě hěn tèbié.
examples.english: Color photos look very realistic, but black-and-white photos also give people a very special feeling.

examples.chinese: 聽見他欣賞的那位歌星來演唱的消息，令他興奮地跳了起來。
examples.pinyin: Tīngjiàn tā xīnshǎng de nà wèi gēxīng lái yǎnchàng de xiāoxi, lìng tā xīngfèn de tiào le qǐlái.
examples.english: Hearing the news that the singer he admires was coming to sing, he jumped up with excitement.

examples.chinese: 那項新產品的設計圖你一個人負責太辛苦了，倒不如找同事一起來做。
examples.pinyin: Nà xiàng xīn chǎnpǐn de shèjìtú nǐ yī gè rén fùzé tài xīnkǔ le, dào bùrú zhǎo tóngshì yīqǐ lái zuò.
examples.english: It's too hard for you to be responsible for that new product's design drawings all by yourself; it would be better to find colleagues to do it together.

examples.chinese: 要是你每天都坐在電腦前，不起來運動運動，遲早會生病的。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ měitiān dōu zuò zài diànnǎo qián, bù qǐlái yùndòng yùndòng, chízǎo huì shēngbìng de.
examples.english: If you sit in front of the computer every day and don't get up to exercise, sooner or later you will get sick.

examples.chinese: 有的房子前院、後院都有花園，住起來一定很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Yǒude fángzi qiányuàn, hòuyuàn dōu yǒu huāyuán, zhù qǐlái yídìng hěn shūfu.
examples.english: Some houses have gardens in both the front yard and the backyard; living there must be very comfortable.

examples.chinese: 自己做的肥皂用起來比較安心，也能選擇自己喜歡的氣味。
examples.pinyin: Zìjǐ zuò de féizào yòng qǐlái bǐjiào ānxīn, yě néng xuǎnzé zìjǐ xǐhuan de qìwèi.
examples.english: Soap made by yourself feels safer to use, and you can also choose the scent you like.

examples.chinese: 露營時我沒帶枕頭，只好把背包當作枕頭，睡起來挺不舒服的。
examples.pinyin: Lùyíng shí wǒ méi dài zhěntou, zhǐhǎo bǎ bēibāo dàngzuò zhěntou, shuì qǐlái tǐng bù shūfu de.
examples.english: When camping, I didn't bring a pillow, so I had to use my backpack as a pillow; sleeping was quite uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 在天氣好的夜晚，星光看起來更加浪漫。
examples.pinyin: Zài tiānqì hǎo de yèwǎn, xīngguāng kàn qǐlái gèngjiā làngmàn.
examples.english: On nights with good weather, the starlight looks even more romantic.

examples.chinese: 醫生說，要是睡前喝了太多水，早上起來時臉就會有點兒腫。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō, yàoshi shuì qián hē le tài duō shuǐ, zǎoshang qǐlái shí liǎn jiù huì yǒudiǎnr zhǒng.
examples.english: The doctor said that if you drink too much water before bed, your face will be a bit swollen when you get up in the morning.

examples.chinese: 我的裙子破了個洞，還好室友有針和線，幫我補了起來。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qúnzi pòle ge dòng, háohǎo shìyǒu yǒu zhēn hé xiàn, bāng wǒ bǔle qǐlái.
examples.english: My skirt had a hole, but luckily my roommate had a needle and thread and helped me mend it.

examples.chinese: 那位新郎的歲數比新娘大十五歲，可是兩人看起來一樣年輕。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi xīnláng de suìshù bǐ xīnniáng dà shíwǔ suì, kěshì liǎng rén kàn qǐlái yīyàng niánqīng.
examples.english: That groom's age is fifteen years older than the bride's, but the two of them look equally young.

examples.chinese: 有人覺得留鬍子比較帥，我倒是覺得留了鬍子看起來比較老。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén juéde liú húzi bǐjiào shuài, wǒ dàoshì juéde liú le húzi kàn qǐlái bǐjiào lǎo.
examples.english: Some people think that having a beard looks more handsome, but I actually think that having a beard makes you look older.

examples.chinese: 我習慣把每一筆支出都記錄起來，提醒自己少花點兒錢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xíguàn bǎ měi yì bǐ zhīchū dōu jìlù qǐlái, tíxǐng zìjǐ shǎo huā diǎnr qián.
examples.english: I am used to recording every expense, to remind myself to spend a little less money.

examples.chinese: 這家工廠使用的大型機械全都是淺綠色的，看起來很有特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng shǐyòng de dàxíng jīxiè quán dōu shì qiǎnlǜsè de, kàn qǐlái hěn yǒu tèsè.
examples.english: The large machinery used in this factory is all light green, and looks very distinctive.

examples.chinese: 她在嬰兒車上安裝了一排不同顏色的小燈，看起來很特別。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yīng'érchē shàng ānzhuāng le yì pái bùtóng yánsè de xiǎo dēng, kàn qǐlái hěn tèbié.
examples.english: She installed a row of small lights of different colors on the stroller; it looks very special.

examples.chinese: 使用高度技術製造出來的工業生產機器，操作起來往往更有效率。
examples.pinyin: Shǐyòng gāodù jìshù zhìzào chūlái de gōngyè shēngchǎn jīqì, cāozuò qǐlái wǎngwǎng gèng yǒu xiàolǜ.
examples.english: Industrial production machines manufactured using highly advanced technology often operate more efficiently.

examples.chinese: 算起來我們已經好久沒吃餃子了，買點兒麵粉、青菜和肉，回家包餃子吧。
examples.pinyin: Suàn qǐlái wǒmen yǐjīng hǎojiǔ méi chī jiǎozi le, mǎi diǎnr miànfěn, qīngcài hé ròu, huí jiā bāo jiǎozi ba.
examples.english: Counting it up, we haven't eaten dumplings for a long time; let's buy some flour, vegetables, and meat, and go home to make dumplings.

examples.chinese: 他把朋友送他的畫先捲起來，等有空時再找地方掛上。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ péngyou sòng tā de huà xiān juǎn qǐlái, děng yǒu kòng shí zài zhǎo dìfang guà shàng.
examples.english: He first rolled up the painting his friend gave him, and when he has time he'll find a place to hang it.

examples.chinese: 我在喝粥時習慣加一些芝麻進去，喝起來很香。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài hē zhōu shí xíguàn jiā yīxiē zhīma jìnqù, hē qǐlái hěn xiāng.
examples.english: When I drink congee, I'm used to adding some sesame seeds; it tastes very fragrant.

examples.chinese: 在吃湯麵之前淋上點兒芝麻油，吃起來味道更好。
examples.pinyin: Zài chī tāngmiàn zhīqián lín shàng diǎnr zhīmayóu, chī qǐlái wèidào gèng hǎo.
examples.english: Before eating noodle soup, drizzle on a little sesame oil; it tastes even better.

examples.chinese: 在抗議新建工廠的活動中，當地的環保團體聯合起來表達他們的需求。
examples.pinyin: Zài kàngyì xīn jiàn gōngchǎng de huódòng zhōng, dāngdì de huánbǎo tuántǐ liánhé qǐlái biǎodá tāmen de xūqiú.
examples.english: In the protest against the construction of a new factory, local environmental groups united to express their demands.

examples.chinese: 請你說明一下，這些產品的功能有什麼差別？
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ shuōmíng yíxià, zhèxiē chǎnpǐn de gōngnéng yǒu shénme chābié?
examples.english: Please explain, what differences are there in the functions of these products?

examples.chinese: 電腦、手機、平板等等，都是3C產品。
examples.pinyin: Diànnǎo, shǒujī, píngbǎn děngděng, dōu shì 3C chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: Computers, cell phones, tablets, and so on are all 3C products.

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: 這裡的每一樣產品都是老闆自己設計的，別的地方找不到相同的。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de měi yí yàng chǎnpǐn dōu shì lǎobǎn zìjǐ shèjì de, bié de dìfang zhǎo bú dào xiāngtóng de.
examples.english: Every kind of product here is designed by the owner himself; you can't find the same ones elsewhere.

examples.chinese: 來來來，快來買！我們3C產品的價格最優惠，品質也很好，快把握機會喔！
examples.pinyin: Lái lái lái, kuài lái mǎi! Wǒmen 3C chǎnpǐn de jiàgé zuì yōuhuì, pǐnzhì yě hěn hǎo, kuài bǎwò jīhuì o!
examples.english: Come, come, come, hurry and buy! Our 3C products have the most favorable prices and very good quality—grab the opportunity!

examples.chinese: 就要開會了，可是我同事還沒把新產品的說明資料準備好，真叫人緊張。
examples.pinyin: Jiù yào kāihuì le, kěshì wǒ tóngshì hái méi bǎ xīn chǎnpǐn de shuōmíng zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo, zhēn jiào rén jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: The meeting is about to start, but my colleague still hasn't prepared the explanatory materials for the new product, which really makes one nervous.

examples.chinese: 這個星期經理一連寫了三個推銷新產品的計畫，每天都忙得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqī jīnglǐ yīlián xiě le sān gè tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de jìhuà, měi tiān dōu máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: This week the manager wrote three plans for promoting new products in succession; he is extremely busy every day.

examples.chinese:
現代各式各樣的科技產品，讓人們的生活更舒適、便利。
這家旅館每個房間都設計得很現代，吸引不少年輕人來訂房。
examples.pinyin:
Xiàndài gè shì gè yàng de kējì chǎnpǐn, ràng rénmen de shēnghuó gèng shūshì, biànlì.
Zhè jiā lǚguǎn měi gè fángjiān dōu shèjì de hěn xiàndài, xīyǐn bù shǎo niánqīngrén lái dìng fáng.
examples.english:
Modern various technological products make people's lives more comfortable and convenient.
This hotel's rooms are all designed in a very modern way, attracting many young people to book rooms.

examples.chinese:
學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。
聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin:
Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí.
Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english:
Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria.
Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: A:對這次新產品的銷售方式，你有什麼想法？ B:我在這方面沒什麼經驗，你可以去請教方經理。
examples.pinyin: A: Duì zhè cì xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu fāngshì, nǐ yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ? B: Wǒ zài zhè fāngmiàn méi shénme jīngyàn, nǐ kěyǐ qù qǐngjiào Fāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: A: Regarding the sales method for this new product, what ideas do you have? B: I don't have much experience in this aspect; you can go ask Manager Fang.

examples.chinese: 如想通過那家企業的面試，就得先熟悉他們的產品特色與銷售方式。
examples.pinyin: Rú xiǎng tōngguò nà jiā qǐyè de miànshì, jiù děi xiān shúxī tāmen de chǎnpǐn tèsè yǔ xiāoshòu fāngshì.
examples.english: If you want to pass that company's interview, you must first be familiar with their product features and sales methods.

examples.chinese: 這次會議的主題跟銷售新產品有關，所以廣告部門的人員得參加。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de zhǔtí gēn xiāoshòu xīn chǎnpǐn yǒuguān, suǒyǐ guǎnggào bùmén de rényuán děi cānjiā.
examples.english: The theme of this meeting is related to selling new products, so the personnel from the advertising department must attend.

examples.chinese: 儘管這次推銷新產品的活動辦得很順利，顧客的反應也很好，不過還是有需要改進的地方。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè cì tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de huódòng bàn de hěn shùnlì, gùkè de fǎnyìng yě hěn hǎo, bùguò háishì yǒu xūyào gǎijìn de dìfāng.
examples.english: Although this event to promote the new product went very smoothly and customers' reactions were also very good, there are still areas that need improvement.

examples.chinese: 經過服務人員詳細地說明，使得客人對公司的產品更了解了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò fúwù rényuán xiángxì de shuōmíng, shǐde kèrén duì gōngsī de chǎnpǐn gèng liǎojiě le.
examples.english: After the service staff's detailed explanation, it made the customers understand the company's products better.

examples.chinese: 今天客人跟著小溫去參觀工廠，也試用了新產品，一切安排都令他十分滿意。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kèrén gēnzhe Xiǎo Wēn qù cānguān gōngchǎng, yě shìyòng le xīn chǎnpǐn, yīqiè ānpái dōu lìng tā shífēn mǎnyì.
examples.english: Today the guests followed Xiao Wen to visit the factory and also tried out new products; all the arrangements made him very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 在地理條件好的地區，不但農產品種類較多，價格也便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zài dìlǐ tiáojiàn hǎo de dìqū, bùdàn nóngchǎnpǐn zhǒnglèi jiào duō, jiàgé yě piányi.
examples.english: In areas with good geographical conditions, not only are there more types of agricultural produce, but the prices are also cheaper.

examples.chinese: 這次茶會主要是為了招待客戶，同時透過這個茶會來發表公司的新產品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì cháhuì zhǔyào shì wèile zhāodài kèhù, tóngshí tòuguò zhège cháhuì lái fābiǎo gōngsī de xīn chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: This tea party is mainly to entertain clients, and at the same time, through this tea party, to launch the company's new products.

examples.chinese: 我們國家出口的農產品很有名，不但價格低，品質又好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen guójiā chūkǒu de nóngchǎnpǐn hěn yǒumíng, bùdàn jiàgé dī, pǐnzhì yòu hǎo.
examples.english: The agricultural products our country exports are very famous; not only is the price low, but the quality is also good.

examples.chinese: 過度消費及使用塑膠材料的產品，都會增加自然環境的負擔。
examples.pinyin: Guòdù xiāofèi jí shǐyòng sùjiāo cáiliào de chǎnpǐn, dōu huì zēngjiā zìrán huánjìng de fùdān.
examples.english: Excessive consumption and the use of plastic material products will both increase the burden on the natural environment.

examples.chinese: 那項新產品的設計圖你一個人負責太辛苦了，倒不如找同事一起來做。
examples.pinyin: Nà xiàng xīn chǎnpǐn de shèjìtú nǐ yī gè rén fùzé tài xīnkǔ le, dào bùrú zhǎo tóngshì yīqǐ lái zuò.
examples.english: It's too hard for you to be responsible for that new product's design drawings all by yourself; it would be better to find colleagues to do it together.

examples.chinese: 經理對新產品計畫的指示不太清楚，我們最好去問清楚。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ duì xīn chǎnpǐn jìhuà de zhǐshì bù tài qīngchu, wǒmen zuì hǎo qù wèn qīngchu.
examples.english: The manager's instructions about the new product plan are not very clear; we'd better go ask and clarify.

examples.chinese: 哎喲，已經半夜一點多了！我們就別再加班寫產品計畫了，等明天再繼續吧！
examples.pinyin: Āiyō, yǐjīng bànyè yìdiǎn duō le! Wǒmen jiù bié zài jiābān xiě chǎnpǐn jìhuà le, děng míngtiān zài jìxù ba!
examples.english: Woah, it's already past one in the morning! Let's stop working overtime to write the product plan, and continue tomorrow!

examples.chinese: 為了使客戶安心使用，我們公司產品訂了嚴格的生產標準。
examples.pinyin: Wèile shǐ kèhù ānxīn shǐyòng, wǒmen gōngsī chǎnpǐn dìng le yángé de shēngchǎn biāozhǔn.
examples.english: In order to let customers use them with peace of mind, our company has set strict production standards for its products.

examples.chinese: 為了人民的健康，許多國家都禁止進口受到環境汙染的農產品。
examples.pinyin: Wèile rénmín de jiànkāng, xǔduō guójiā dōu jìnzhǐ jìnkǒu shòudào huánjìng wūrǎn de nóngchǎnpǐn.
examples.english: For the health of the people, many countries prohibit the import of agricultural products that have been polluted by the environment.

examples.chinese: 公司不斷推銷新型電子產品，通常是為了刺激客戶購買。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī bùduàn tuīxiāo xīnxíng diànzǐ chǎnpǐn, tōngcháng shì wèile cìjī kèhù gòumǎi.
examples.english: Companies constantly promote new types of electronic products, usually in order to stimulate customers to buy.

examples.chinese: 手機廠商時常邀請明星替他們的產品宣傳。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī chǎngshāng shícháng yāoqǐng míngxīng tì tāmen de chǎnpǐn xuānchuán.
examples.english: Mobile phone manufacturers often invite celebrities to promote their products.

examples.chinese: 自動化工廠不僅使生產速度更快，同時也能保證產品品質。
examples.pinyin: Zìdònghuà gōngchǎng bùjǐn shǐ shēngchǎn sùdù gèng kuài, tóngshí yě néng bǎozhèng chǎnpǐn pǐnzhí.
examples.english: Automated factories not only make production speed faster but also can guarantee product quality.

examples.chinese: 我們公司在這次電子展共發表了九項新產品，並吸引不少國外客戶來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī zài zhè cì diànzǐ zhǎn gòng fābiǎo le jiǔ xiàng xīn chǎnpǐn, bìng xīyǐn bù shǎo guówài kèhù lái cānguān.
examples.english: Our company altogether launched nine new products at this electronics exhibition, and attracted many foreign clients to visit.

examples.chinese: 他對發展新科技向來保守，不願接受人工智慧產品。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì fāzhǎn xīn kējì xiànglái bǎoshǒu, bù yuàn jiēshòu réngōng zhìhuì chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: He has always been conservative about developing new technology and is unwilling to accept artificial intelligence products.

examples.chinese: 這家工廠奪下了著名品牌產品的製造機會。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng duó xià le zhùmíng pǐnpái chǎnpǐn de zhìzào jīhuì.
examples.english: This factory seized the manufacturing opportunity for a famous brand's products.

examples.chinese: 這個影片介紹了亞洲的飲食文化。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yǐngpiàn jièshào le Yàzhōu de yǐnshí wénhuà.
examples.english: This video introduced Asia's food culture.

examples.chinese: 媽媽替我報名了亞洲鋼琴比賽，她說只要我肯努力，一定會有好成績的。
examples.pinyin: Māma tì wǒ bàomíngle Yàzhōu gāngqín bǐsài, tā shuō zhǐyào wǒ kěn nǔlì, yīdìng huì yǒu hǎo chéngjī de.
examples.english: My mother signed me up for the Asian Piano Competition. She said that as long as I am willing to work hard, I will definitely get good results.

examples.chinese: 這家電腦公司本來只服務亞洲地區的民眾，現在服務範圍已經擴大到歐洲了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diànnǎo gōngsī běnlái zhǐ fúwù Yàzhōu dìqū de mínzhòng, xiànzài fúwù fànwéi yǐjīng kuòdà dào Ōuzhōu le.
examples.english: This computer company originally only served people in the Asian region, but now its service range has already expanded to Europe.

examples.chinese: 這次亞洲文化展，除了樂器表演，還有傳統服裝試穿活動，歡迎各位來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì Yàzhōu wénhuà zhǎn, chúle yuèqì biǎoyǎn, hái yǒu chuántǒng fúzhuāng shìchuān huódòng, huānyíng gèwèi lái cānguān.
examples.english: This Asian Culture Exhibition, in addition to musical instrument performances, also has traditional clothing try-on activities; everyone is welcome to visit.

examples.chinese: 亞洲地區發生了嚴重的流行病，使人民受到相當大的生活壓力。
examples.pinyin: Yàzhōu dìqū fāshēng le yánzhòng de liúxíngbìng, shǐ rénmín shòudào xiāngdāng dà de shēnghuó yālì.
examples.english: A serious epidemic broke out in the Asian region, causing people to receive considerable life pressure.

examples.chinese: 亞洲地區發生了戰爭，使人民生活上所受的的壓力相當大。
examples.pinyin: Yàzhōu dìqū fāshēng le zhànzhēng, shǐ rénmín shēnghuó shàng suǒ shòu de yālì xiāngdāng dà.
examples.english: War broke out in the Asian region, causing the pressure that people received in life to be considerable.

examples.chinese: 他對亞洲文化相當有興趣，計畫將來走遍全亞洲。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì Yàzhōu wénhuà xiāngdāng yǒu xìngqù, jìhuà jiānglái zǒu biàn quán Yàzhōu.
examples.english: He is quite interested in Asian culture and plans to travel all over Asia in the future.

examples.chinese: 這家國際企業因商品銷售情況不理想，決定退出亞洲市場。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā guójì qǐyè yīn shāngpǐn xiāoshòu qíngkuàng bù lǐxiǎng, juédìng tuìchū Yàzhōu shìchǎng.
examples.english: This international enterprise, because product sales were not ideal, decided to withdraw from the Asian market.

examples.chinese: 我有一個幸福美滿的家庭，父母都很愛我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge xìngfú měimǎn de jiātíng, fùmǔ dōu hěn ài wǒ.
examples.english: I have a happy and fulfilling family; my parents both love me very much.

examples.chinese: 大寶明年有去英國留學的打算，所以找了家庭教師幫他補習， 希望提高英文程度。
examples.pinyin: Dàbǎo míngnián yǒu qù Yīngguó liúxué de dǎsuàn, suǒyǐ zhǎo le jiātíng jiàoshī bāng tā bǔxí, xīwàng tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù.
examples.english: Dabao plans to study abroad in the UK next year, so he found a private tutor to help him with cram tutoring, hoping to improve his English level.

examples.chinese: 李小姐結婚以後的生活重心就是家庭，尤其是照顧剛出生的小孩。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě jiéhūn yǐhòu de shēnghuó zhòngxīn jiùshì jiātíng, yóuqí shì zhàogù gāng chūshēng de xiǎohái.
examples.english: After Miss Li got married, the focus of her life is her family, especially taking care of her newborn child.

examples.chinese:
王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。
每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin:
Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn.
Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english:
Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family.
After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 小藍從小在育幼院長大，最大的願望就是將來能有一個溫暖的家庭。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lán cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, zuì dà de yuànwàng jiùshì jiānglái néng yǒu yī gè wēnnuǎn de jiātíng.
examples.english: Xiao Lan grew up in an orphanage; her greatest wish is to have a warm family in the future.

examples.chinese: 人人都渴望浪漫的愛情和幸福的家庭，不過自由自在的單身生活也是不錯的。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu kěwàng làngmàn de àiqíng hé xìngfú de jiātíng, búguò zìyóuzìzài de dānshēn shēnghuó yě shì búcuò de.
examples.english: Everyone longs for romantic love and a happy family, but a free and easy single life is also not bad.

examples.chinese:
時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了。
在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
examples.pinyin:
Shídài jìnbù le, nǚrén zài jiātíng hé shèhuì zhōng de dìwèi yě gēnzhe tígāo le.
Zài gǔdài Zhōngguó, nánrén bù yīnggāi jìn chúfáng de chuántǒng guānniàn, yě yīnwèi shídài de gǎibiàn ér bùtóng.
examples.english:
Times have progressed, and women's status in the family and society has risen accordingly.
In ancient China, the traditional concept that men should not enter the kitchen has also changed with the times.

examples.chinese: 要維持社區良好的生活品質，就要從不亂丟垃圾、減少家庭噪音做起。
examples.pinyin: Yào wéichí shèqū liánghǎo de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, jiù yào cóng bù luàn diū lèsè, jiǎnshǎo jiātíng zàoyīn zuò qǐ.
examples.english: To maintain a good quality of life in the community, we must start by not littering and reducing household noise.

examples.chinese: 為了愛惜食物資源，同時也幫助生活困難的家庭，張老闆決定在國內開幾家食物銀行。
examples.pinyin: Wèile àixī shíwù zīyuán, tóngshí yě bāngzhù shēnghuó kùnnán de jiātíng, Zhāng lǎobǎn juédìng zài guónèi kāi jǐ jiā shíwù yínháng.
examples.english: In order to cherish food resources and at the same time help families with financial difficulties, Boss Zhang decided to open several food banks in the country.

examples.chinese: 不論是工業或家庭廢水，對人們的健康都有不好的影響。
examples.pinyin: Bùlùn shì gōngyè huò jiātíng fèishuǐ, duì rénmen de jiànkāng dōu yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Whether industrial or household waste water, it all has a bad impact on people's health.

examples.chinese: 家裡用不到的毯子可以拿給環保社團，他們會送給需要的家庭。
examples.pinyin: Jiālǐ yòng bù dào de tǎnzi kěyǐ ná gěi huánbǎo shètuán, tāmen huì sòng gěi xūyào de jiātíng.
examples.english: Blankets that are not used at home can be given to environmental groups; they will give them to families in need.

examples.chinese: 想擁有一段百年好合的婚姻，除了真心的愛情之外，也應重視家庭的責任。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yǒngyǒu yī duàn bǎiniánhǎohé de hūnyīn, chúle zhēnxīn de àiqíng zhīwài, yě yīng zhòngshì jiātíng de zérèn.
examples.english: If you want to have a marriage that is a harmonious union forever, in addition to genuine love, you should also value family responsibility.

examples.chinese: 大龍最近買了一套音響，每天回到家就聽他最愛的英國樂團的音樂。
examples.pinyin: Dàlóng zuìjìn mǎi le yī tào yīnxiǎng, měitiān huí dào jiā jiù tīng tā zuì ài de Yīngguó yuètuán de yīnyuè.
examples.english: Dalong recently bought a stereo set; every day when he gets home, he listens to music by his favorite British band.

examples.chinese: 我們樂團今晚的表演很成功，一起放煙火來慶祝吧！
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yuètuán jīnwǎn de biǎoyǎn hěn chénggōng, yīqǐ fàng yānhuǒ lái qìngzhù ba!
examples.english: Our band's performance tonight was very successful; let's set off fireworks together to celebrate!

examples.chinese: 樂團主唱的唱歌技巧，對樂團演出表現的影響相當大。
examples.pinyin: Yuètuán zhǔchàng de chànggē jìqiǎo, duì yuètuán yǎnchū biǎoxiàn de yǐngxiǎng xiāngdāng dà.
examples.english: The lead vocalist's singing skills have a considerable impact on the band's performance.

items.wordHook: Combining 樂(music) and 團(sphere): 樂團 means band.

examples.chinese: 氣象預報說，從明天起一連三天，中部以北地區氣溫只有十五度，出門時最好加件外套。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào shuō, cóng míngtiān qǐ yīlián sān tiān, zhōngbù yǐběi dìqū qìwēn zhǐyǒu shíwǔ dù, chūmén shí zuìhǎo jiā jiàn wàitào.
examples.english: The weather forecast says that starting tomorrow for three days in a row, the temperature in the central and northern regions will be only 15 degrees; when going out, it's best to add a jacket.

examples.chinese: 最近天氣不太穩定，氣溫的變化很大，出門時最好帶把傘。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì bú tài wěndìng, qìwēn de biànhuà hěn dà, chūmén shí zuìhǎo dài bǎ sǎn.
examples.english: The weather has been unstable recently, and the temperature changes a lot; when going out, it's best to bring an umbrella.

examples.chinese: 科學家早就證明了氣溫的變化對農業生產有不好的影響，可是到目前還找不到解決的好辦法。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zǎo jiù zhèngmíng le qìwēn de biànhuà duì nóngyè shēngchǎn yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng, kěshì dào mùqián hái zhǎo bú dào jiějué de hǎo bànfǎ.
examples.english: Scientists proved long ago that temperature changes have a bad effect on agricultural production, but up to now they still cannot find a good solution.

examples.chinese: 今天氣溫只有零下(below zero)三度，我家沒暖氣，不管穿多厚的衣服，全身還是冰冰的。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān qìwēn zhǐyǒu língxià sān dù, wǒ jiā méi nuǎnqì, bùguǎn chuān duō hòu de yīfu, quánshēn háishì bīngbīng de.
examples.english: Today the temperature is only three degrees below zero. My home has no heater, and no matter how thick the clothes I wear, my whole body still feels icy cold.

examples.chinese: 地球氣溫越來越高，世界各地氣候的變化也越來越明顯。
examples.pinyin: Dìqiú qìwēn yuè lái yuè gāo, shìjiè gèdì qìhòu de biànhuà yě yuè lái yuè míngxiǎn.
examples.english: The Earth’s temperature is getting higher and higher, and climate changes around the world are also becoming more and more obvious.

examples.chinese: 天氣不穩定的時候，氣溫也時時跟著變化(to change,to vary)。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì bù wěndìng de shíhou, qìwēn yě shíshí gēnzhe biànhuà.
examples.english: When the weather is unstable, the temperature also constantly changes along with it.

items.wordHook: Combining 氣(air) and 溫(warm): 氣溫 means temperature.

examples.chinese:
時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了。
在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
examples.pinyin:
Shídài jìnbù le, nǚrén zài jiātíng hé shèhuì zhōng de dìwèi yě gēnzhe tígāo le.
Zài gǔdài Zhōngguó, nánrén bù yīnggāi jìn chúfáng de chuántǒng guānniàn, yě yīnwèi shídài de gǎibiàn ér bùtóng.
examples.english:
Times have progressed, and women's status in the family and society has risen accordingly.
In ancient China, the traditional concept that men should not enter the kitchen has also changed with the times.

examples.chinese: 這個學期中文課的新教材是時代華語第三冊，一共有十六課。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xuéqī Zhōngwén kè de xīn jiàocái shì Shídài Huáyǔ dì-sān cè, yígòng yǒu shíliù kè.
examples.english: This semester’s new Chinese course teaching material is Modern Chinese Volume 3, which has sixteen lessons in total.

examples.chinese: 不少博物館裡的藝術品都是從古代保留到現代的，具有重要的時代意義。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo bówùguǎn lǐ de yìshùpǐn dōu shì cóng gǔdài bǎoliú dào xiàndài de, jùyǒu zhòngyào de shídài yìyì.
examples.english: Many artworks in museums have been preserved from ancient times to the present and have important historical significance.

examples.chinese: 在雲端科技發達的時代裡，人人都能夠透過網路交友、學習。
examples.pinyin: Zài yúnduān kējì fādá de shídài lǐ, rénrén dōu nénggòu tòuguò wǎnglù jiāoyǒu, xuéxí.
examples.english: In an era of advanced cloud technology, everyone can make friends and learn through the internet.

examples.chinese: 每個時代都有自己的價值標準，社會習俗及生活規矩也常隨著時代改變。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge shídài dōu yǒu zìjǐ de jiàzhí biāozhǔn, shèhuì xísú jí shēnghuó guījǔ yě cháng suízhe shídài gǎibiàn.
examples.english: Every era has its own value standards, and social customs and life rules also often change with the times.

examples.chinese: 科學家在他的時代所努力的結果，都可能會在未來開花結果。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zài tā de shídài suǒ nǔlì de jiéguǒ, dōu kěnéng huì zài wèilái kāihuā jiéguǒ.
examples.english: The results of scientists' efforts in their era may all bear fruit in the future.

examples.chinese: 在自由戀愛的時代中，還是有人透過相親的方式來認識另一半。
examples.pinyin: Zài zìyóu liàn'ài de shídài zhōng, háishì yǒu rén tòuguò xiāngqīn de fāngshì lái rènshi lìng yībàn.
examples.english: In this era of free love, there are still people who get to know their other half through blind dates.

examples.chinese: 我跟朋友的愛好一樣，都喜歡露營。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn péngyou de àihào yíyàng, dōu xǐhuan lùyíng.
examples.english: My friend and I have the same hobby—we both like camping.

examples.chinese: 她愛好化妝、穿名牌服裝，目的是希望別人讚美她。
examples.pinyin: Tā àihào huàzhuāng, chuān míngpái fúzhuāng, mùdì shì xīwàng biérén zànměi tā.
examples.english: She loves makeup and wearing name-brand clothes; her purpose is to hope others praise her.

examples.chinese: 我跟幾個愛好歷史的朋友一起組了社團，專門研究古文物。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn jǐ ge àihào lìshǐ de péngyǒu yìqǐ zǔ le shètuán, zhuānmén yánjiū gǔ wénwù.
examples.english: I formed a club together with several friends who love history, specifically to study ancient artifacts.

examples.chinese: 我姑姑的房間裡有淡淡的玫瑰花味兒，那種氣味真香。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gūgu de fángjiān lǐ yǒu dàndàn de méiguīhuā wèir, nà zhǒng qìwèi zhēn xiāng.
examples.english: There is a faint rose scent in my aunt's room; that smell is really fragrant.

examples.chinese: 這道菜是用新鮮蔬果做的，不僅味道甘甜，對健康也有好處。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài shì yòng xīnxiān shūguǒ zuò de, bùjǐn wèidào gāntián, duì jiànkāng yě yǒu hǎochù.
examples.english: This dish is made with fresh vegetables and fruits; not only does it taste sweet, but it is also good for your health.

examples.chinese: 有一些中式餐廳的桌上會擺一壺茶，要式客人覺得菜太油，就能喝口茶，解解嘴裡油膩的味道。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē zhōngshì cāntīng de zhuō shàng huì bǎi yī hú chá, yào shì kèrén juéde cài tài yóu, jiù néng hē kǒu chá, jiě jiě zuǐ lǐ yóunì de wèidào.
examples.english: Some Chinese restaurants place a pot of tea on the table; if guests feel the food is too oily, they can take a sip of tea to reduce the greasy taste in their mouths.

examples.chinese: 他沖咖啡的技術很好，香味總是比別人沖的濃。
examples.pinyin: Tā chōng kāfēi de jìshù hěn hǎo, xiāngwèi zǒngshì bǐ biérén chōng de nóng.
examples.english: His coffee-brewing technique is very good; the aroma is always stronger than that of coffee brewed by others.

examples.chinese: 哇！這家小吃店的臭豆腐好辣、好臭哇！怎麼有客人受的了這種味道哇？
examples.pinyin: Wa! Zhè jiā xiǎochī diàn de chòu dòufu hǎo là, hǎo chòu wa! Zěnme yǒu kèrén shòu de liǎo zhè zhǒng wèidào wa?
examples.english: Wow! The stinky tofu at this snack shop is so spicy and smells so stinky! How can any customer stand this smell?

examples.chinese: 要是你覺得這盤菜的味道太淡了，可以加一點醬料。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ juéde zhè pán cài de wèidào tài dàn le, kěyǐ jiā yìdiǎn jiàngliào.
examples.english: If you feel this dish's flavor is too light, you can add a little sauce.

examples.chinese: 電影明星一向很重視自己的穿著，合適的穿著才能讓他們更有品味、更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng míngxīng yīxiàng hěn zhòngshì zìjǐ de chuānzhuó, héshì de chuānzhuó cái néng ràng tāmen gèng yǒu pǐnwèi, gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Movie stars have always attached great importance to their clothing; only suitable clothing can make them have more taste and more confidence.

examples.chinese: 小張不僅長得帥，穿著也很有品味，所以很多人都以為他是明星。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng bùjǐn zhǎng de shuài, chuānzhuó yě hěn yǒu pǐnwèi, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi tā shì míngxīng.
examples.english: Xiǎo Zhāng is not only handsome but also dresses with great taste, so many people think he is a celebrity.

examples.chinese: 我認為多看時尚雜誌、多看模特兒怎麼穿衣服，應該就能使自己的穿著更有品味。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi duō kàn shíshàng zázhì, duō kàn mótè'er zěnme chuān yīfu, yīnggāi jiù néng shǐ zìjǐ de chuānzhuó gèng yǒu pǐnwèi.
examples.english: I think that by reading more fashion magazines and looking more at how models wear clothes, you should be able to make your own clothing more tasteful.

examples.chinese: 你在名牌服裝的專櫃工作，我想聽聽看你對穿著和品味的看法。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài míngpái fúzhuāng de zhuānguì gōngzuò, wǒ xiǎng tīng tīng kàn nǐ duì chuānzhuó hé pǐnwèi de kànfǎ.
examples.english: You work at a designer clothing counter; I'd like to hear your opinion on dressing and taste.

examples.chinese: 臭豆腐是臺灣有名的小吃，不過味道很獨特，不是每個人都能接受。
examples.pinyin: Chòu dòufu shì Táiwān yǒumíng de xiǎochī, búguò wèidào hěn dútè, bú shì měi ge rén dōu néng jiēshòu.
examples.english: Stinky tofu is a famous snack in Taiwan, but its flavor is very unique; not everyone can accept it.

examples.chinese: 小韓一直受不了臭豆腐的味道，昨天終於克服了心理障礙，把臭豆腐吃下去了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hán yīzhí shòu bù liǎo chòu dòufu de wèidào, zuótiān zhōngyú kèfú le xīnlǐ zhàng'ài, bǎ chòu dòufu chī xiàqù le.
examples.english: Xiao Han has always been unable to stand the smell of stinky tofu; yesterday he finally overcame his psychological obstacle and ate the stinky tofu.

examples.chinese: 那家店正在推銷巧克力口味的小籠包，我們要不要去嘗試一下？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn zhèngzài tuīxiāo qiǎokèlì kǒuwèi de xiǎolóngbāo, wǒmen yào bù yào qù chángshì yīxià?
examples.english: That shop is promoting chocolate-flavored soup dumplings; shall we go try them?

examples.chinese: 王老闆舉辦了一個免費吃鬆餅的活動，目的是調查哪種口味的鬆餅最受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎobǎn jǔbàn le yīgè miǎnfèi chī sōngbǐng de huódòng, mùdì shì diàochá nǎ zhǒng kǒuwèi de sōngbǐng zuì shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Boss Wang held an event with free waffles; the purpose was to investigate which flavor of waffle is most popular.

examples.chinese: 到底哪一種冰淇淋最好吃，得看個人的口味。
examples.pinyin: Dàodǐ nǎ yì zhǒng bīngqílín zuì hǎochī, děi kàn gèrén de kǒuwèi.
examples.english: Which kind of ice cream is the most delicious ultimately depends on individual taste.

examples.chinese: 到底哪一種冰淇淋最好吃，得看個人的口味。
examples.pinyin: Dàodǐ nǎ yì zhǒng bīngqílín zuì hǎochī, děi kàn gèrén de kǒuwèi.
examples.english: Which kind of ice cream is the most delicious ultimately depends on individual taste.

examples.chinese: 我在公園散步的時候，聞到了花的香味。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài gōngyuán sànbù de shíhou, wén dào le huā de xiāngwèi.
examples.english: When I was taking a walk in the park, I smelled the fragrance of flowers.

examples.chinese: 你聞，那是什麼味道？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wén, nà shì shénme wèidào?
examples.english: Smell it—what is that smell?

examples.chinese: 媽媽做的菜，味道很香。
examples.pinyin: Māma zuò de cài, wèidào hěn xiāng.
examples.english: The food Mom makes smells very good.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的菜，味道都很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài, wèidào dōu hěn hǎo.
examples.english: The dishes at this restaurant all taste very good.

examples.chinese: 自己做的肥皂用起來比較安心，也能選擇自己喜歡的氣味。
examples.pinyin: Zìjǐ zuò de féizào yòng qǐlái bǐjiào ānxīn, yě néng xuǎnzé zìjǐ xǐhuan de qìwèi.
examples.english: Soap made by yourself feels safer to use, and you can also choose the scent you like.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠排出的黑煙不只氣味難聞，更可怕的是可能對肺部造成傷害。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng pái chū de hēiyān bùzhǐ qìwèi nánwén, gèng kěpà de shì kěnéng duì fèibù zàochéng shānghài.
examples.english: The black smoke emitted by that factory not only smells bad, but even more frighteningly, it may cause harm to the lungs.

examples.chinese: 在吃湯麵之前淋上點兒芝麻油，吃起來味道更好。
examples.pinyin: Zài chī tāngmiàn zhīqián lín shàng diǎnr zhīmayóu, chī qǐlái wèidào gèng hǎo.
examples.english: Before eating noodle soup, drizzle on a little sesame oil; it tastes even better.

examples.chinese: 我習慣在家裡放一盆花，讓室內有鮮花的香味。

examples.english: My friend thinks that if there is no drinking at a birthday party, there won't be a joyous atmosphere.

examples.pinyin: Měi dào zhòngdà jiérì, chéngshì lǐ jiù dàochù chōngmǎn le huānlè de qìfēn.
examples.english: Whenever a major festival arrives, the city is filled everywhere with a joyful atmosphere.

examples.english: When professional baseball teams are playing, they invite professional cheerleading squads to create a lively atmosphere.
